chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Malakuiias.
Jano' ba' gu Yo dha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't gu Esauu xibhɨk gu Jakob tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu maa'nkar na ba' oidha' jix gaki.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Edom tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tɨɨt gu Probinkia gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bhaan oidha' gɨ' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu mar nɨidhat gu taat tu duukam gu Jawatan; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' gu taat gu ñi'ook nɨidhat tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook choo'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu takarui' ñaanbi'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bai'ñchu' na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' cham cham bhai' na pai' dhuuk jix bhai'x ka'ook cham cham bhai' gu Preseentalo gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' ka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' no'ch; gio ba' dhi' gu novɨ suudai' u'va; mi' dhɨr boopoya' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gio cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob jix tas duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu novɨ ka't.

Na gu' na gu' dɨr pai' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm pai' jix duñia' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' bɨx pai' gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook jugi.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x ka'ook gu maa'nkar; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' juraa'n gu chio'ñ kakneer jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ mu'ai bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan gu vupui bɨɨx boopoya'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook na ba' jum duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Lebii tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka't bɨɨx gu oidha' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n; na gu' vupui bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' juruuñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu'r juruuñ gu chin tu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't bakia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨx bhai' jix jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' nukadham matda' gu chin gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga; na gu' mattuda' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mui'x ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Lebii tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gio bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan cham tu'x jai'ch cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na tu a'ga namki'.
Jano' ba' cham tañia' bɨx gu taat cham tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Por gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n xibhɨk ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨx tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Israeel gu Jerusalem tu' jix duñia'; na gu' gu Judaa tu' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx mar u'vɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vaak zel gu Jakob gu chio'ñ jix duñia' dhi' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios suakɨt gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; na ba' cham na ba' bɨɨx gu novɨ.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook cham maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook maa'n na ba' gu kai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kɇkɇɇda' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan gu u'vɨ cham.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx tɨi'chu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr kɇkɇɇda' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' no'x cham bhai' duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Ñiok, aañ jix juu'ñdha' guch juu'ñdham na bhaankam jix bhaai'chdha' gu bhóogɨt bhaan iñ xoi'kam.
Na pai' dhuuk chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook namkia' chɨkka gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk na gu' na ja'p gu tai na ja'p.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii na ja'p jix uam jodai na ja'p jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar bɨɨx bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu Judaa gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' jix duñia' ñi'ookdham bhaan; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam xoi'kam ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ua'tulhdhidha' choo'n tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Jakob cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh tattat jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham; gio ba' tu' bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' boosgi.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mu'ai na gu' gu ja'tkam bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx boosgi ulhña' ka't jugi gu vaak; gio ba' jano' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' cham bhi'spio'kai gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm daam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook cham gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' yooxi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gammɨjɨx; na gu' boopoya' gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu juan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu ñi'ook gio xoi'kam; gio ba' xoi'kam vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook maa'n duiñchu'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai ka't ua'nak u'uan chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan na ba' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chumñigam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tanoolh tu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jir bhai' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh na ja'p; gio ba' bɨx xoi'kam tu' na cham jir bhai' ka't dhi'; mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ɨlhdham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham kiicha' tu' tatk tu'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tas bɨx bhai' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios na ja'p ali' vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat ka't maatai gu vaas tɨɨt gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees tu duukam gu oreb ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ba' bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jootsa' gu Eliiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan va'k gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tattat gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam tattat; gio ba' cham ka't tu' bɨɨx chajaañ gu oidha'.
